properties.description: When a project owns no instruction file at all — the ordinary state of a repo that has never been agent-worked, and therefore of an adopt target — the installer CREATES the primary-harness convention carrying a pointer to the kit's own file, instead of only appending to files that already exist. Narrow on purpose: a project that already owns any instruction convention gets a line appended to it and nothing invented, and the created file stays a pointer rather than a second home for instructions.
properties.name: The install lands where the agent will actually read it
